title: Max's Art Project
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for the McKinley Bulldogs.

pages: Max's class is making paper collages for the school hallway. Each student will make a picture of their favorite place at McKinley. Max chooses the garden, with the tall sunflowers and the planter boxes.

Max cuts green paper for leaves and yellow paper for petals. Max glues everything down very carefully. It looks great! Then Max reaches for the scissors and knocks over a cup of blue paint. Splash! Blue paint drips across the whole picture.
Max wants to crumple it up and throw it away. Instead, the art teacher looks closely. "Hmm," she says. "What could this blue become?"

Max tilts the paper and squints. The blue paint looks a little like a river, or maybe a sky full of rain. Max gets an idea. Max adds raindrops with a white crayon and paints tiny boots on the planter boxes. Now it is the garden on a rainy day!
When the collages go up in the hallway, kids stop to look at Max's picture. "I love the rain!" says a first grader. Max smiles. Sometimes a mistake is just the beginning of a better idea.
